description: N59 learned melodies from the hand-transposed N56 melody (A aeolian over Am7), form AB AB AA BC, moved onto the chords Am7 Em7 Dm7 C6 (one per bar), the final note of each 4-bar cycle (beat 3 of bar 4) drawn from the overall pitch frequency times the position table, not fixed. Notes starting on 16ths 10-16 of bar 2 are deleted (a gap at the end of bar 2).
